passAt1Note: A re-measurement never replaces the verdict it re-measures, so run 39266782346's strict passAt1 stays null exactly as it was, and this batch has no pass@1 of its own. What it can produce is the run's repaired pass rate: scripts/frontier-harness-repaired-reading.mjs --official publishes it over the run's predeclared task set, with both verdicts of every re-measured cell, the class each was admitted under and the extra-attempt count disclosed.

admission.rule: AGENTS.md:11 — a declared re-measurement is the only way an already-graded cell may be measured again, and it never replaces the verdict it re-measures. Each cell below already carries a canonical verdict from run 39266782346 (all eleven are disposition=failed with a verifier-graded rewards object), so none of them is 'recovered': each receives exactly one extra attempt, admitted under the variance-check class, with the same candidate, the same provider and effort, the same per-cell official budget, the same grader and the same generation parallelism as the source run. No cell receives a second extra attempt.
admission.class: variance check — the source verdict stands and is not replaced; the extra attempt asks whether the same frozen composition produces the same terminal state
admission.disclosure: All eleven cells were graded: each carries a verifier-graded rewards object with reward 0. Five of them show terminalCause=completed (the agent finished inside its budget and the delivered workspace did not satisfy the verifier); the other six show terminalCause=stopped, i.e. their agent phase used its whole declared budget before delivering. The budget is NOT extended for this re-measurement (AGENTS.md forbids it and the source composition is kept identical), so for those six a repeated exhaustion is the expected outcome and is reported as such rather than attributed to the re-run.

mitigation.declaredCompositionDelta: Two datacurve cells of this set (httpx, arktype) are delivered from digest-pinned GHCR mirrors instead of anonymous public.ecr.aws pulls; the other nine cells run on their frozen images with an unchanged transport. The mirror list, the digest proofs and the in-job alias guard are declared in config/frontier-harness-recovery-39266782346.json#mitigation and are not repeated here. No budget, effort, candidate, instruction or grader changes.
mitigation.notAConditionThatMakesTheCellPassable: For the nine cells whose images are unchanged, nothing about the composition changes at all; for the two datacurve cells the image bytes are digest-identical, so the change is transport only.

constraints: Every verdict of run 39266782346 is preserved: this re-measurement is committed beside the frozen record and never inside it, and the run's own report.json, artifacts and counts are untouched.
Exactly one extra attempt per cell, never a second chance at that attempt.
The strict passAt1 stays null for the source run and for this batch: the counted attempts exceed what a single-attempt metric allows, so the published figure is the repaired pass rate, not a pass@1.
Same candidate pin, provider, effort, official budgets, grader and generation parallelism as run 39266782346.

dispatchInputs.note: The plan job refuses a run that predeclares more than 10 tasks, so these eleven cells are re-measured by two runs that share the candidate, provider, effort, budgets and generation parallelism declared in config/frontier-harness-recovery-39266782346.json#dispatchInputs: dispatch A (six datacurve cells, mirror transport) carries httpx and arktype, and dispatch B (ten terminal-bench cells) carries the other nine. Both runs select their cells with explicit `fh_tasks` (offset/limit would select corpus-order neighbours that this manifest does not name). This manifest names only its own cells.

knownRisks.budgetRepeat: Six cells already used their whole declared budget; with the budget unchanged, a repeated exhaustion is the most likely outcome and is disclosed, not worked around.
knownRisks.providerTransport: A transport death would leave a cell's extra attempt without a verdict; the source verdict then simply stands.
knownRisks.finality: One extra attempt per cell; a second dispatch for any of these cells is not permitted by AGENTS.md.
